chapters.title: The Impossible Note
chapters.summary: The protagonist meets the first anomaly and loses the safety of routine.
chapters.content: Lin Che began the morning inside a routine scene, trusting the ordinary instruments of medical sci-fi. The case looked harmless until one detail echoed the novel's central premise: A neurologist discovers memories hidden in tremors. Mira arrived before he could explain it away, carrying a warning that made the first clue feel deliberate.
